title: Sorrell Documentation configuration
description: Configuration for a Sorrell documentation website. Save this file as docs.config.json and reference this schema with the $schema property for editor completion and validation.

$schema.description: URL of this schema. Add this property to docs.config.json to enable validation and completion in VS Code and other JSON Schema-aware editors.

agent.description: Settings for generated agent-readable documentation artifacts and the optional MCP endpoint.

api.description: Settings for generating API reference pages from TypeScript modules and configured JSON Schemas.

banner.description: Optional settings for the generated Open Graph banner.

footer.description: Footer link columns, copyright message, and links shown at the lower right of landing and documentation pages.

landing.description: Landing page content, including its title, summary, primary action, and content sections.

manifests.description: Generated artifact manifest entries used to track site, API reference, Storybook, or project outputs.

metadata.description: Basic site identity used for page titles, descriptions, branding, and repository links.

navigation.description: Optional grouped navigation tree for documentation pages.

packages.description: Packages represented by the documentation site, including their names, versions, and source directories.

redirects.description: Permanent or temporary path redirects emitted for the generated site.

routing.description: URL prefixes used to mount documentation and Storybook alongside the landing page.

storybook.description: Settings for including a Storybook application and its stories in the site.

tokens.description: Light and dark theme color overrides. Unspecified values use the built-in theme defaults.

vercel.description: Vercel deployment settings for the site and its separately deployed documentation, landing, Storybook, or MCP projects.

versions.description: Documentation versions available in the version selector. Mark one entry as current to identify the default version.

banner.description: Settings for the generated 1200 by 630 Open Graph banner.

backgroundColor.description: CSS color for the banner background. Defaults to tokens.light.background.

logoHeight.description: Maximum logo height in pixels. The logo keeps its aspect ratio.

logoWidth.description: Maximum logo width in pixels. The logo keeps its aspect ratio.

footerLink.description: A link shown in a footer column or in the footer's lower-right link row.

icon.description: Optional icon name for the link, such as github.

label.description: Accessible and visible name of the link.

footerColumn.description: A titled group of links in the upper footer area.

footer.description: Site footer content shared by the landing and documentation sites. The message supports {year} and {name} placeholders.

columns.description: Groups of links displayed as footer columns.

links.description: Links displayed at the lower right of the footer.

message.description: Message displayed at the lower left. {year} and {name} are replaced with the current year and site name.

repository.description: A source repository location and optional source-relative directory and branch.

branch.description: Branch or ref containing the source files.

directory.description: Repository-relative directory containing the relevant project or package.

url.description: Repository URL. A GitHub URL may include a branch or directory fragment.

metadata.description: Site-wide identity and metadata. Values here provide defaults for page metadata and landing content.

description.description: Default site description used in metadata and when landing.description is omitted.

logo.description: An image URL or site-relative path displayed in the site header.

name.description: Stable site or product name used by generated tooling and metadata.

title.description: Human-readable site title used in the header and document titles.

url.description: Canonical base URL for the published site. An empty string is allowed for local or preview-only sites.

colorTokens.description: Partial color overrides for one theme. Values are CSS color strings, such as hex, rgb(), or color().

accent.description: Primary accent color for links, highlights, and interactive states.

cardBackground.description: Background color for raised cards and panels.

codeBackground.description: Background color for inline and block code.

proseForeground.description: Default text color for authored prose and API descriptions.

subtleForeground.description: Secondary text color for captions, metadata, and subdued labels.

tokens.description: Theme-specific color overrides. Each theme is optional and may specify only the colors that differ from defaults.

dark.description: Color overrides used when the dark theme is active.

light.description: Color overrides used when the light theme is active.

navigationItem.description: A page, section, or external destination in the documentation navigation. Items may contain nested children.

children.description: Nested navigation items displayed beneath this item.

href.description: Destination URL or path for this item.

id.description: Stable unique identifier for this item.

kind.description: Destination kind: a documentation page, an in-page section, or an external link. Defaults are selected by the site when omitted.

label.description: Text shown for this navigation item.

navigationGroup.description: A labeled group of navigation items, such as Guides or API Reference.

id.description: Stable unique identifier for this group.

label.description: Group heading shown in the navigation.

navigation.description: Grouped documentation navigation. Omit groups to use the navigation derived from authored content.

version.description: A documentation version and the location from which its pages are served.

current.description: Whether this is the default version selected when a reader opens the site.

directory.description: Content directory for this version, relative to the configured documentation content root.

href.description: Optional URL or path override for this version.

id.description: Stable identifier used in routes and generated version metadata.

label.description: Text displayed in the version selector. When omitted, a label is derived from the version metadata.

order.description: Sort order for this version in the selector; lower values appear first.

version.description: Version number shown in version metadata, for example 1.2.3.

package.description: A documented package or product represented by the site.

directory.description: Package source or documentation directory, relative to the repository or configured root.

id.description: Stable identifier for this package entry.

name.description: Package name, commonly its npm package name.

source.description: Repository location for this package, when it differs from the site repository.

version.description: Package version displayed in generated documentation metadata.

landingSection.description: An editable content section on the generated landing page.

href.description: Optional destination linked from this section.

landing.description: Landing page text and actions. Detailed composition and component layout are edited in the generated Astro source files.

description.description: Landing page summary. Defaults to metadata.description when omitted.

primaryAction.description: Main call-to-action link displayed on the landing page.

href.description: Destination path or URL for the action.

sections.description: Landing page content sections. The generated page may provide default sections when this is omitted.

title.description: Landing page heading. Defaults to metadata.title when omitted.

redirect.description: A path redirect emitted for the generated site.

status.description: HTTP redirect status code: 301 for permanent or 302 for temporary. Defaults are selected by the target platform when omitted.

command.description: Command used to build or run the Storybook application, when configured.

directory.description: Storybook project directory, relative to the repository root.

stories.description: Glob patterns identifying Storybook story and documentation files.

url.description: Published Storybook URL, if Storybook is hosted separately.

api.description: API reference generation settings for TypeScript modules, Doxygen XML projects, and configured JSON Schemas.

doxygen.description: C++ API projects described by Doxygen XML generated before Sorrell Docs runs.

projects.description: Named C++ projects whose Doxygen XML contributes reference pages.

enabled.description: Whether API reference generation is enabled.

entryPoints.description: TypeScript files passed to TypeDoc as API entry points.

items.description: A source file path relative to the repository root.

jsonSchemas.description: JSON Schema files and routes for generated reference pages.

outputDirectory.description: Directory in which generated API reference data is written.

packages.description: Workspace package names included in API reference generation.

sourceRepository.description: Repository metadata used to create API source links.

typedoc.description: Additional TypeDoc options passed through to TypeDoc. TypeDoc option names and values are intentionally unrestricted.

doxygenProject.description: A C++ project and the Doxygen XML directory generated by its build.

id.description: Stable URL-safe project identifier used in API routes.

name.description: Project name shown in API navigation.

version.description: Project version shown in API reference metadata.

xmlDirectory.description: Repository-root-relative Doxygen XML directory containing index.xml and compound files.

jsonSchemaReference.description: A repository-root-relative Draft 2020-12 JSON Schema and its public route.

path.description: Repository-root-relative path to the JSON Schema file.

route.description: Public route. A route not beginning with /docs is normalized to begin with /docs.

routing.description: Path prefixes for applications hosted alongside the landing site.

documentationPrefix.description: Path prefix where the documentation site is served, commonly /docs.

storybookPrefix.description: Path prefix where Storybook is served, commonly /storybook.

vercelProject.description: Deployment and routing settings for one Vercel project.

directory.description: Project root directory relative to the repository.

id.description: Vercel project identifier, when configured directly.

origin.description: Origin URL for the deployed project.

routePrefix.description: Path prefix associated with this project in the combined site.

team.description: Vercel team or scope name that owns the project.

vercelProjects.description: Per-project Vercel deployment settings. Each project entry can override shared deployment values.

documentation.description: Vercel project serving the documentation site.

landing.description: Vercel project serving the landing page.

mcp.description: Optional Vercel project serving the MCP endpoint.

vercel.description: Vercel deployment configuration shared by the site's deployment tooling.

domains.description: Custom domains associated with the deployment.

items.description: A domain name, such as docs.example.com.

enabled.description: Whether Vercel deployment integration is enabled.

outputDirectory.description: Build output directory deployed by Vercel.

productionBranch.description: Git branch associated with production deployments.

project.description: Default Vercel project name when a per-surface project is not specified.

projects.description: Project-specific Vercel settings for site surfaces.

team.description: Default Vercel team or scope that owns the project.

manifest.description: Metadata describing one generated artifact and its source revision.

checksum.description: Checksum of the generated artifact, when available.

generatedAt.description: Timestamp when the artifact was generated.

path.description: Path or URL identifying the generated artifact.

revision.description: Source control revision used to generate this artifact.
